task.title: Record the runtime request-to-step provenance change on L5b and L1
task.objective: At 3699617f L5a's failure evidence records runtime request provenance: each http.error, network.failed and page.errorDocument event carries a stable request id kept across redirects, its response and a later transfer failure, the step and time it was issued, its frame, and a navigation or responseWait link when the runner itself holds the request, the failure record carries the failed step's target page and frame, and requestRelations separates confirmed relations from uncertain ones without inferring from co-occurrence. verify:request-provenance is 59/0 through the real engine with three mutations caught, the failure-analysis request is byte-identical with and without provenance, and the overhead gate is 18/0 PASS. Prompts, the model, deadlines, cause selection and the automatic analysis (off) are unchanged. Append a note to awkit-djnl.8 and to awkit-djnl.1 giving the change, the result and the next blocker. Refresh the JSONL export. Nothing closes: both stay in_progress. No edge is added or removed. The lease writes .beads/** only, so the owner's untracked scripts/offline-benchmark/ and the already-edited state documents are outside it and untouched.

acceptance.description: awkit-djnl.8 and awkit-djnl.1 stay in_progress, each with a note naming the change commit and its verified result, no edge changes, the JSONL export is refreshed from the database, and the dashboard reports that its sources agree.

evidence.notes: 177/177 with the Overview banner on 'Sources agree' on round 1, after the two `bd update --append-notes`, `bd export -o .beads/issues.jsonl` (303 issues) and the already-edited state documents: 9 outstanding / 294 closed with 135 edges, unchanged, and both narratives restating 65 PASS / 2 NOT RUN / 0 BLOCKED. Round 2 ran once after the lease release, because active-lease.json is a registered source, and was again 177/177 'Sources agree' with the same counts.

history.released_reason: request-provenance change noted on awkit-djnl.8 and awkit-djnl.1, nothing closed, no edge changed, export refreshed
